Einstein, D., Worrell, E. and Khrushch, M. (2001). Steam systems in industry: Energy use and energy efficiency improvement potentials. Proceedings of the 2001 ACEEE Summer Study on Energy Efficiency in Industry, Vol. 1. Lawrence Berkeley National Laboratory report, eScholarship http://escholarship.org/uc/item/3m1781f1 (publication date 2001-07-22).

Locators are PDF page numbers of the eScholarship copy (the paper itself carries no page numbers; p.1 is the eScholarship cover). Main file: boiler efficiencies by fuel (coal 81-85, oil 78-81, gas 76-81%, HHV, reprinted from OIT 1998). _measures: Tables 5-7 (16 boiler and distribution measures, savings, paybacks, implementation potential, cost of conserved energy; total 1181-1258 PJ, 18.5-20% of steam system energy). _other-values: Tables 1, 2 and 4 US statistics (food 706 PJ). No capital costs printed anywhere. Traps: CCE uses a 30% discount rate and has no stated price year (1994 fuel prices); the 83% flash-steam figure is a case study the authors exclude.
